title: Share full board behavior across console and embedded consumers
description: Ryan requires strict DRY for canonical Kanbus console, Papyrus CMS and Prospectus CRM (Cyclotron consumers also adopt). Export a reusable full board module owning collapse/default/persistence and existing board behavior; preserve theme/config/transport boundaries, filter/hierarchy/selection/mobile behavior. Both canonical console and Papyrus adopt same export; local regression proof, immutable pin, no publish/deploy. Given any consumer of the shared board, when a column is collapsed or expanded with pointer/keyboard, then identical shared behavior applies and configured/default/persisted state is respected.

IssueCollection composes same Board, now forwards detailOpen and columnStateKey. Removed dead copied console BoardColumn markup in favor of shared re-export. Config status collapsed typed; React18/19 peers supported. New specs first reproduced disabled headers, then 32 scenarios/183 steps pass. Real console 1440/390 collapse/reload/default/width/keyboard/detail/type/hierarchy passes; typechecks/build pass. Papyrus running8899 now uses exact packed d618b714 export: collapse reclaims197px at1440/390/844, list/type/reload persistence and selection/Escape pass; fullheight and approved sidebar/account/tab regressions pass. No drag/drop exists in baseline; not fabricated. Preparing isolated shared-UI-only release branch excluding unrelated API/backend pending work.
